project_type: Flask web application with SQLite database, Bootstrap frontend, Flask-Login authentication
build_system: pip with requirements.txt; no compile step required
test_framework: Manual testing only (no automated test suite found in codebase)
verification_instructions: Start Flask dev server with 'flask run', navigate to http://localhost:5000/login, verify Microsoft SSO button appears, test OAuth2 flow with valid Microsoft account, confirm authentication logs written to logs/erpportal.log with [AUTH] tag, test role-based dashboard access, test logout clears session
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - no build artifacts or generated code to commit
environment_constraints: SQLite database at tas_erp.db in worktree root; requires Azure AD app registration with redirect URI configured; requires .env file with Azure credentials; logs directory must exist and be writable; FLASK_ENV controls dev vs prod behavior
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code style: 4-space indentation, docstrings on functions, structured logging with app.logger, Blueprint pattern for routes, Flask-Login for sessions, WTForms for CSRF protection (OAuth callback exempt), rate limiting with Flask-Limiter
key_patterns: Config loaded from environment via config.py classes (Config, DevelopmentConfig, ProductionConfig); app factory pattern in app/__init__.py create_app(); blueprints registered in create_app (auth_bp, admin_bp, employee_bp); models use Flask-SQLAlchemy db instance; User model implements Flask-Login UserMixin with get_id() returning string; role-based decorators @admin_required and @employee_required in app/auth.py; templates extend base.html with blocks 'title' and 'unauthenticated_content'; logging configured in create_app with RotatingFileHandler to logs/erpportal.log; existing username/password auth preserved in database schema
directory_structure: Root contains config.py, run.py, requirements.txt, .env files, schema.sql, README.md; app/ contains __init__.py (factory), models.py (SQLAlchemy), forms.py (WTForms), auth.py (decorators), utils.py (helpers); app/routes/ contains auth.py (authentication), admin.py (admin routes), employee.py (employee routes); app/templates/ contains base.html, login.html, admin/, employee/, errors/ subdirectories; app/static/ contains css/, js/, uploads/; logs/ directory for erpportal.log; .agents/tasks/entra-sso/ contains design documents and implementation plan
